records.issue_text: [BUG] header.scss calls @include flexbox()/align-items()/order() without any @import of common/foundation/mixins, so SCSS compilation fails with "Undefined mixin" unless some file already globally imports mixins.scss. The stylesheet build (assets:precompile / dev reload) aborts with a Sass "Undefined mixin 'flexbox'" error at header.scss, breaking the entire stylesheet bundle, not just the header — unless every consumer imports the mixin file in this diff, which none do.

records.issue_text: [BUG] The .small-action-desc padding change from '0.5em 0 0.5em 4em' to '0 1.5%' removes the 4em left indent that compensated for the topic-avatar column, changing the rendered layout of every small-action (topic closed, deleted user, small-action banners) with no connection to header layout performance. Users see small-action descriptions shift left into the avatar column on every topic; this visual regression is invisible in a header-focused review and is not traceable to the stated PR intent.
records.rationale: The diff shows `.small-action-desc` padding changed from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%` (topic-post.scss). This definitively removes the fixed 4em left offset that likely reserved horizontal space next to `.topic-avatar`, and the same hunk also changes `.small-action` to a flex container. That combination can plausibly cause the description content to shift left relative to the avatar area, i.e., a layout regression across all `.small-action` instances. The exact rendered overlap cannot be proven from CSS alone, but the mechanism (removal of left indent) is directly supported by the diff.

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The panel is positioned via order(3) while .extra-info-wrapper gets order(2) in topic.scss, but .title and .contents' other children get no order, splitting the ordering contract for one flex container across two files with no shared definition. The next dev who reorders header children must discover that ordering is spread between header.scss (.panel order 3) and topic.scss (.extra-info-wrapper order 2) plus DOM-order defaults; the .contents flex container's layout rules now live in two stylesheets, and a change in one file silently reflows the other's layout (e.g., bumping .panel to order 1 does not move it before extra-info because that order lives elsewhere).
records.rationale: The finding assumes a single flex container whose children are being ordered across two files (header.scss and topic.scss), but the diff does not show that. In header.scss, the flex container is `.contents { ... @include flexbox(); ... }` and `.panel { ... @include order(3); }` is presumably a child there. In topic.scss, the change is a standalone `.extra-info-wrapper { @include order(2); ... }` with no `.contents` nesting or any linkage to the header `.contents` selector. This contradicts the claim that “the .contents flex container's layout rules now live in two stylesheets.”

records.issue_text: [BUG] The PR's stated intent is a performance optimization (flexbox mixins), but it silently deletes the .small-action-desc left padding of 4em and replaces it with 1.5% padding, plus removes margin-top: 5px — a visual redesign, not a perf change. Every small-action row (topic close/archive/flags notices) visibly shifts: the description text no longer clears the 45px avatar and instead squeezes to 1.5% from the container edge, causing text to overlap/abut the avatar on narrow screens; users see unannounced visual regressions with no acceptance of the new layout.
